customCurlOptions.description: Other curlOptions such as --data-binary, --ssl, -v that customers wants to include in the command

hostUrl.description: HostUrl for the uploaded file, defaults to host url of the action.

env.description: Environment for the uploaded file, defaults to env of the action.

app.description: App for the uploaded file, defaults to app of the action.

authenticationKind.description: The kind of authorization token such as OAuth, Basic, Bearer etc

authenticationToken.description: The token used to authenticate curl command

title: This type is the base type for all specs related {@link Curl} to generate curl commands
name: CurlSpec
